subject: Console: Atlas Retail — sudden tenant spike (temporary triage & views requested)
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Grace Oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Mills <sarah@atlasretail.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Console: Atlas Retail — sudden tenant spike (temporary triage & views requested)

Team — spotted a sharp anomaly for Atlas Retail in the Console this morning (US‑EAST). Highlights: token spend up ~4x vs baseline over the last 2h, 95th %-tile tail latency doubled, and we see a small number of requests falling to fallback variants. Screenshot attached.

Ask: can product/eng + infra stand up a short-lived tenant slice in Console (per‑tenant heatmap + token distribution by model + KV cache hit ratio) and a short triage playbook we can share with the customer? We need:
- a prioritized diagnostic dashboard within 6–8 hours
- a playbook with clear next steps (what to toggle, when to open an SLA fallback)
- a short list of metrics to monitor over the next 24h

Context: Atlas is on a reserved Dedicated plan; this is heading toward a support escalation if we can’t give them clear signal/mitigation. Sarah — looping you so you have visibility; are you able to approve short‑term verbose logs for that tenant if we request them?

Attachments: console_spike_screenshot.png (snapshot of Console overview)

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace Oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 09:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Console: Atlas Retail — sudden tenant spike (temporary triage & views requested)

Ben — thanks for the flag and the screenshot. I opened OBS‑4593 in Jira and added the initial incident notes (link below). Immediate actions I recommend:
1) Infra: check if model routing policy had any overrides in the last 3 hours (can routing fallback explain the token jump?).
2) Provision a temporary dashboard slice focused on this tenant (time windows: 08:00–09:00, 09:00–10:00 PST).
3) CS to ask Atlas for consent to enable 24h debug logs (I’ll handle the ask).

I’ve attached the event log snippet from the Console that shows the timestamped bursts (ma-event-4593.log).

Evelyn
Customer Success Manager
Evelyn.Hart@redwood.com

Related: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/OBS-4593
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace Oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 10:30:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Console: Atlas Retail — sudden tenant spike (temporary triage & views requested)

Thanks — a couple quick clarifying asks from Product:
- Can we get the raw token distribution CSV for the affected window (token buckets broken down by model and route)? That will tell us whether a single model or route drove the spend.
- Any evidence of increased batch sizes or KV cache miss spikes?

I can carve out a temp Console tile (tenant heatmap + per‑model token/sec + KV hit ratio) and push it as an admin‑only view. Grace — can you own the short‑lived UI change? ETA if we prioritize: ~6 hours.

I’ll pause any broad rollout of the tile until CS/AE confirm we should expose it to Atlas.

— Karthik
Product Manager, Observability
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
From: Grace Oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 13:00:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Console: Atlas Retail — temporary tenant heatmap / triage metrics

I’ll take the UI change. Proposed minimal metric set for the temporary dashboard:
- per‑model token/sec and per‑model token cost
- 95/99 P50 tail latency (token latency) by model
- KV cache hit ratio (per‑route)
- batch size distribution and batch‑trigger rate
- quantization fallback events count (if any)
- fallback routing counts (how often requests dropped to cheaper variants)

ETA: I can have an admin‑only tile up in ~6 hours but need the tenant token CSV and the exact prioritized time windows (Evelyn: please confirm). I’ll also need a short lived feature flag to enable debug logging for that tenant if CS gets consent.

If infra sees that routing fallback is the driver, we should surface a single action button in the playbook: revert to pinned model variant + reduce max_batch_size for that tenant.

Grace
Staff SWE, Console Observability
grace.oconnor@redwood.com
From: Sarah Mills <sarah@atlasretail.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 14:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Console: Atlas Retail — sudden tenant spike (temporary triage & views requested)

Thanks for the quick attention. We approve short‑term debug logs for 24 hours (consent attached). Please note this spike is showing on our end as well — procurement is already asking whether there will be any automatic billing adjustments or credits while you triage. Any guidance on expected cost exposure in the next 24h would be helpful.

— Sarah
VP Product, Atlas Retail
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: All
Cc: Sarah Mills <sarah@atlasretail.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 16:33:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Console: Atlas Retail — sudden tenant spike (temporary triage & views requested)

Summary / next steps (owners & ETA):
- Evelyn (CS): confirm debug consent (done) and update Atlas procurement re: interim guidance (action: Evelyn, ETA 30m)
- Grace (Eng): admin‑only tenant heatmap tile + metric set (action: Grace, ETA ~6h from now)
- Karthik (Product): assemble short playbook (toggle steps, fallback criteria, rollback instructions) and a one‑pager for the customer (action: Karthik, ETA 4h)
- Infra (Markus): check routing policy and KV cache telemetry; flag any automated fallback triggers (action: Markus, ETA 2h)
- Ben (AE): draft customer note and coordinate credit/contract ask if necessary (action: Ben, ETA 1h)

Links & artifacts: Jira OBS‑4593, tenant_token_buckets.csv (attached), atlas_debug_consent.txt (attached), HubSpot deal DL‑2034.

If anyone needs me to raise this as an SLA escalation to leadership, say so now — otherwise we’ll proceed with the triage plan above and I’ll keep Atlas updated.

Thanks, everyone.
Ben Carter
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
